name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Add a separate editable JSON overlay for exceptional holidays and personal dates while keeping normal statutory holidays in compact yearly 366-bit caches. orbclo_orbitdev.events.json supports one-off YYYY-MM-DD dates, yearly MM-DD dates, fixed ranges, yearly ranges, type, label, color and blink. Extra events overlay today/holiday/weekend colors; later JSON entries override earlier ones. Double-tap date selection remains the highest visual layer and blinks yellow. The event JSON is preserved as app data and is reloaded whenever 5wCal opens.
